D1-M01: Mihran Spah's Aswaran held both flank objectives from Battle Round 1. When Hellkin walked off the 3 VP centre in Round 2, a 10 RP Sagdid Hound-Keepers took it, and the Spah scored 19 objective VP in Rounds 3–5. The Procession's Morphean Engines and the Pontifex's Vessel of Agares slowed the Spah but never won ground back; 8 of its 15 VP came from BREAK THEIR HOLD.
D1-M16: The Golden Tumen's four CHARACTER-led squads made LEAD FROM THE FRONT pay 3 VP in each of the first three rounds, because a joined pair counts twice, and the Tumen completed all four secondaries. The Restless Dead out-damaged them 86 to 44 but lost the centre after Round 1, and a Round 4 Countercharge threw the Firelake Warden onto Genghis Khan and gave away ASSASSINATION.
D1-M21: The Flamewrought Company's Javidan Immortals walked onto the centre and the right in Round 1 and held both for all four rounds (20 VP), then took the left in Round 4 as well. The Belfry Battery's guns did 13 damage between them; its Archistrategos won the one fight it picked, for ERADICATE THE FOE, but the left in Rounds 2 and 3 was its only objective VP.
D1-M23: The Lightbearers led 23–13 after three rounds, behind the Goetic Ophanim's 11-HP Fractured Horizon and the Seraph of Evolution on the centre. But every cheap unit that gave them control was shot or cut down, while Longwu Army kept refilling its line with Commandery Bannermen through two Troop Requisitions; in Round 5 Longwu took all three objectives plus FORWARD PRESENCE and IRON GRIP, 13 VP in one round, for a 34–30 win.
D1-M02: Magdeburg Warhost reached the objective line first, held the centre and west from Round 1 and all three from Round 3, and won without losing a unit. The Black Huskarls and Otto of Saxony broke the Legionnaire Squads in melee, while the Armoured Cohort's Equites Igniferi and second Chiron Battle Tank stood idle and its infantry fell back off the objectives.
D1-M04: Blaze of Etna won the fighting, 44 damage to 25, without losing a unit, but kept every unit on the centre. The Fencibles' Parish Militia and Eire Pathfinders held both flank objectives unopposed from Round 2, and with IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS and three secondaries that was a 36–12 win in Round 4.
D1-M05: The objectives and secondaries came out almost level (15+10 to 14+10), so the Primary decided it, 8–2: Sampo's Song's BREAK THEIR HOLD scored every round from Round 2 and blocked half of the Opoki Hundred's STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION. The Peijaiset Wardens charged the centre back in Round 4 and a Secure Objective kept the left in Round 5.
D1-M06: The Archistrategos, the Knight-Apostle Squad and the Golgothic Paladins took the centre in Round 2 and destroyed the Silesian Hammerguards and two Commonwealth Fusilier squads there without losing a hit point. Oath of Kraków's damage went almost all into 10 RP Covenant Levies (20 RP destroyed for 141 lost), and the Legion's Round 4 paid 17 VP.
D1-M07: The Wolfshead Pack trailed 19–12 after three rounds, then its Assault Lycanthropes, Wendigo Manreaver and Beast-Monk destroyed Sword of Allah's flank garrisons in Rounds 4 and 5. DEBT OF BLOOD paid 6 for the two marked kills, and the Pack's secondaries beat Sword of Allah's 9–3.
D1-M08: Legio XIII's two Ironthunder Vanguard squads destroyed five Bailiffs units in melee and held the 3 VP centre from Round 1 to Round 5, and the Morale failures their charges forced paid most of COORDINATED SUPPRESSION's 9 VP. The Bailiffs led 9–6 on the flanks after Round 2, then walked both crusader pairs off them in Round 3.
D1-M09: Merlin and the Knight-Excisors took the centre on a Round 1 Double Time and held it all five rounds, the Knight-Ascendants held the left, and the Cosán Sí Host never scored an objective: its 10 VP were 9 from IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS and 1 from STRONGPOINT.
D1-M10: The Summer Rade's fast Sidhe units took all three objectives in Round 1 and again in Round 6. The Moonless Veilblades (42 damage), Blackflint Archers and Wild Hunt Riders destroyed seven Vigil units for two, while the Vigil of Masis spent 23 CP on Double Times and Troop Requisitions that decided nothing.
D1-M11: Mawkin 2, the Poxknight and Hellkin charged the Etxe Riflemen off the centre in Round 2 and the Sineaters held it to the end (15 VP); the Beast of Contagion took the left from Round 3. The Oak's Basajaun Smith held the right all battle, but the Oak destroyed one enemy unit in six rounds.
D1-M12: The Judgement held all three objectives by Round 2, lost the centre and the right in Round 3, and charged the centre back with Odin's Einherjar in Round 4: 13 VP that round. The Ghosts' IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid its full 9, but they held objectives only in Rounds 3 and 4.
D1-M13: The Mouseion won without destroying a unit and dealt 6 damage all battle: with nine units against four it completed a secondary every round (11 VP), scored FORLORN HOPE three times and held the flanks. The Protectores held the centre from Round 2, but Palatine Custos 1 and 2 (140 RP) made five charges and never attacked.
D1-M14: The Veiled Court held the 3 VP centre in all six rounds, 18 of its 22 objective VP, after its two Babylonian Assassins destroyed Temple Levy 2 and 3 there in Round 2. Walls of Uruk outscored it on Primary and secondaries (18 to 11) but never got back onto the centre.
D1-M15: The Cossacks rode onto the centre and the left in Round 1 and led 8–0, but in Round 2 the two flying Michaelite Brethren destroyed Host Sotnia 1, Host Sotnia 2 and both their leaders in two attacks. The Bulava never scored again; Chonae Wing held all three objectives in Rounds 3 and 4 and lost no unit.
D1-M17: The Sidhe reached the centre and the left after one move and held all three objectives after two, for a 16–2 lead. The Winter Host took the centre and the left back in Round 3, but Veche Levy 1 fell back off the centre in Round 4 and Glandore passed 30.
D1-M18: Kishomon Company led for four rounds, but BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Murderhost every round it contested an objective and its melee destroyed the three Ashigaru squads one by one. A Round 4 Countercharge threw the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery into Furyforged Berserkers on ten Blood Frenzy stacks for ASSASSINATION, and the Murderhost took all three objectives in Round 6 to finish on exactly 30.
D1-M20: Alea Iacta's Advances put Caesar and Ironthunder Vanguard 1 on the centre and the Champion of Mars on the right objective in Round 1, and the Popinjay Guild never put any OC on the right. Ironthunder Vanguard 1's Round 2 charge sent four Guild units back through failed Fall Back tests; by Round 4 Alea Iacta held all three objectives, 19 objective VP to 5.
D1-M22: The Soudarion Cortege led 24–22 after Round 5, mostly from LEAD FROM THE FRONT, but its Primary then hit the 10 VP cap, which also paid the Brigade's STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION. The Alembic Brigade held the flanks with Muqatila Troopers 2, the Royal Alchemist and the Abna al-Dawla Guard, completed five secondaries to two, and won the last round 11–1.
D1-M24: The Scorpion Shields' Praetorian Strikers cut through the Column's Levies and led from Round 2 to Round 5 (28–25). Then the Golgothic Paladins and the Knight-Apostle Squad destroyed six of the Shields' eight units, 195 RP to 66, and in Round 6 the Column's centre, right objective and LEAD FROM THE FRONT took it from 25 to 31.
D1-M03: Akathist Convent held the centre in every round and all three objectives from Round 2, with four 10 RP Covenant Levies squads and the Field Confessor scoring 20 of its 32 VP. The Seven-Sword Intercessor and the Maphorion Nuns destroyed the Retiarius Squad and the Palatine Custos (Mounted) in the centre's area; the five-unit Celeritas Squadron never controlled an objective.
D1-M19: The Cappadocian Riders held the centre and the left in all four rounds, winning the centre 12–11 on OC after Crimson Knights 1 and the Dragoon Brethren broke off charges without leaving its area. The Horns of Hattin, three bodies against five, scored 9 VP from LEAD FROM THE FRONT, and in Round 4 Saladin's pair walked off the right objective, which gave the Riders the 5 VP that ended it.
